description: baseline: current Effect-native implementation plus planning/autoresearch setup

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline migration debt before replacing Effect core with Web Standards primitives.
asi.notes: Checks pass on existing Effect-native code; metric counts implementation-facing Effect references only, not docs comparison text.

description: baseline: corrected metric excludes Datastar data-effect references

asi.hypothesis: Reset baseline with migration metric that counts Effect library/runtime references but not Datastar's data-effect attribute.
asi.metric_fix: Removed lowercase effect word match because it penalized legitimate Datastar effect attributes and helper names.
asi.rollback_risk: None; checks still pass on unchanged implementation.

description: feat: migrate core to Web Standards Request/Response SDK

asi.hypothesis: A direct Web Standards rewrite can remove all Effect runtime/schema/core abstractions while preserving Datastar DSL, HTML rendering, SSE semantics, and example coverage.
asi.kept_changes: Rewrote read around Request+Standard Schema, reply around native Response/ReadableStream, removed contract/live core exports, converted examples/tests/docs/package metadata, added Hono example.
asi.correctness: typecheck, full Vitest suite, and build passed through autoresearch.checks.sh.
asi.tradeoffs: Removed schema-derived contracts and core live.query; live behavior is now a recipe in examples/docs; examples use fetch-compatible handlers.

description: baseline: zero-debt Web Standards core maintenance surface

asi.hypothesis: After completing the migration, use a composite maintenance-surface metric that keeps migration debt at zero and only then rewards smaller core source.
asi.constraints: Do not remove behavior to chase size; checks and tests must preserve Datastar protocol coverage.

description: chore: simplify SSE response construction

asi.hypothesis: reply.patch and reply.signals do not need eventStream when wrapping a single already-framed Datastar SSE event.
asi.result: Removed an unnecessary import/helper path; protocol output unchanged by tests.
asi.risk: Low; this is a pure simplification and checks passed.

description: chore: avoid double-merging default response headers

asi.hypothesis: Passing default header constants into the response helper avoids redundant sse/html header helpers and keeps user header override semantics unchanged.
asi.result: Reduced core source while all response header tests still pass.
asi.risk: Low; behavior covered by reply response tests and full checks.

description: chore: drop unused stream source type alias

asi.hypothesis: The public stream input type is enough; the older EventSource alias is redundant after accepting strings, iterables, async iterables, and Web Streams directly.
asi.result: Removed one unnecessary exported type alias with checks passing.
asi.risk: Low in this experimental branch; root API remains unchanged.

description: chore: simplify Datastar signal method check

asi.hypothesis: A two-method branch is simpler than allocating a Set for GET/DELETE Datastar query-signal detection.
asi.result: Slightly smaller read helper; request decoding tests still pass.
asi.risk: Very low; methods are fixed by Datastar transport semantics.

description: chore: inline Datastar signal JSON parsing

asi.hypothesis: The parseJson helper was only used once; inlining keeps SignalParseError behavior while reducing indirection.
asi.result: Slightly smaller read helper with parse/validation error tests passing.
asi.risk: Low; error class and thrown shape unchanged.

description: chore: remove redundant page response init alias

asi.hypothesis: Page responses use native ResponseInit directly; a PageResponseInit alias adds public surface without extra meaning.
asi.result: Removed redundant type alias; page status/header tests still pass.
asi.risk: Low in experimental branch; native ResponseInit is clearer.

description: chore: inline local signal name normalization

asi.hypothesis: The private signal helpers in ds.ts are single-use indirection; inlining them into local keeps the same typed private-name behavior with less core surface.
asi.result: Reduced source size while all Datastar signal/type/HTML/tests/build checks passed.
asi.risk: Low; local() behavior is covered by validation-form and signal-name tests, and type shape remains PrivateSignalName<Name>.

description: chore: remove obsolete SignalRecord type

asi.hypothesis: SignalRecord only existed to support the removed schema-contract proxy API; after removing contract, exporting it adds stale public surface without a core use case.
asi.result: Removed the unused type while preserving direct ds.signal/local authoring and all tests/build/typecheck.
asi.risk: Low for this greenfield branch; it intentionally breaks the old contract-oriented API.

description: chore: remove empty Datastar modifier aliases

asi.hypothesis: SignalKeyModifiers and ClassModifiers were empty aliases for the shared case-modifier shape; using the shared internal type trims stale public surface without changing accepted options.
asi.result: Removed two empty exported interfaces; ref/indicator/dataClass/dataComputed still accept the same structural options and all checks passed.
asi.risk: Low for this greenfield SDK branch; consumers lose two mostly redundant importable type names but behavior is unchanged.

description: chore: simplify case modifier suffix construction

asi.hypothesis: Case modifier suffixes are simple enough to build directly; removing appendCaseModifier avoids an internal helper without changing Datastar modifier output.
asi.result: Reduced core source while modifier, Datastar attribute, typecheck, test, and build checks all passed.
asi.risk: Low; case modifier behavior is covered by modifier/attribute tests and remains structurally identical.

description: chore: collapse signal-name validation regex

asi.hypothesis: A single whole-name regex can enforce the same Datastar dotted signal-name grammar as split/every segment validation with less code and no behavior loss.
asi.result: Reduced core source while signal-name tests and full typecheck/test/build checks passed.
asi.risk: Low; the regex preserves non-empty dotted segments with optional leading underscores and is covered by signal-name tests.

description: chore: remove unused expression tag fields

asi.hypothesis: Expr values are identified by the toDatastarExpression method, so the extra _tag discriminant on RawExpr/Signal adds public/runtime surface without behavior.
asi.result: Removed Expr _tag from interface and classes; expression rendering, typed coverage, typecheck, tests, and build all passed.
asi.risk: Low for the greenfield branch; this breaks only code inspecting the internal tag rather than using the documented expression method.

description: chore: remove unused core error tag fields

asi.hypothesis: Web Standards core errors are typed by their classes and instanceof checks, so Effect-style _tag fields on core error classes are unnecessary public/runtime surface.
asi.result: Removed _tag from SignalParseError, SignalValidationError, SignalNameError, and NavigationUrlError; tests now assert issues/instances instead and full checks passed.
asi.risk: Medium-low: this is a deliberate greenfield API break for code pattern-matching _tag, but it aligns with plain Error classes and existing examples use instanceof.

description: chore: remove internal HTTP method type export

asi.hypothesis: HttpMethod was only used by the internal fetchAction helper; users call ds.get/post/put/patch/delete rather than importing a method-name type.
asi.result: Removed the exported alias and kept the internal union on fetchAction; full typecheck/test/build checks passed.
asi.risk: Low for the greenfield SDK branch; public function behavior and option types are unchanged.

description: chore: simplify heartbeat race sentinel with Symbol

asi.hypothesis: Use a Symbol sentinel in reply.withHeartbeat to avoid wrapping event/heartbeat race results in tagged objects.
asi.rollback_reason: TypeScript did not narrow the Symbol sentinel out of the Promise.race union, so result.done/result.value were rejected by typecheck.
asi.next_action_hint: Retry with an object sentinel whose identity is compared directly, or add a typed alias/cast only if it remains simpler and readable.
asi.error_details: TS2339/TS2551 in src/reply.ts for result.done/result.value on symbol | IteratorResult<EventChunk>.

description: chore: simplify heartbeat race result handling

asi.hypothesis: Use the async iterator result directly in heartbeat racing and only wrap the heartbeat branch with a small sentinel object, reducing internal tagged-object plumbing while preserving cancellation and heartbeat behavior.
asi.result: Reduced reply.ts source; heartbeat/live stream tests plus full typecheck/test/build passed.
asi.risk: Low; behavior is covered by stream heartbeat and live counter tests. This follows the failed Symbol attempt but keeps TypeScript narrowing simple.

description: chore: inline stream heartbeat option stripping

asi.hypothesis: withoutHeartbeat was a single-use helper in reply.stream; destructuring heartbeat directly in stream keeps the public option shape and avoids extra indirection.
asi.result: Reduced reply.ts source while stream headers, heartbeat/live behavior, typecheck, tests, and build all passed.
asi.risk: Low; behavior is covered by stream and live-counter tests, and the helper was private.

description: chore: pass direct response default headers directly

asi.hypothesis: Direct response helpers can pass their dynamic default headers into the shared response helper instead of pre-merging headers and wrapping init again.
asi.result: Reduced reply.ts source while preserving user header override semantics and all direct response/header tests, typecheck, tests, and build passed.
asi.risk: Low; response() already owns default-header merging and direct response tests assert content-type/datastar headers.

description: chore: inline navigation control-character check

asi.hypothesis: The navigation control-character predicate is used once; inlining the regex preserves the safety check with less private helper surface.
asi.result: Reduced reply.ts source while navigation safety tests, typecheck, full tests, and build passed.
asi.risk: Low; reply.navigate tests cover unsafe control characters and allowed/blocked origins.

description: chore: inline Datastar primitive value union

asi.hypothesis: DatastarPrimitive was a one-use alias inside DatastarValue and not part of the blessed Web Standards SDK surface; inlining the primitive union reduces stale type surface without changing value semantics.
asi.result: Reduced ds.ts source while Datastar value typing, examples, typecheck, tests, and build passed.
asi.risk: Low for the greenfield branch; external code importing DatastarPrimitive would need to spell the primitive union directly.

description: chore: inline fetch option helper unions

asi.hypothesis: RetryMode, RequestCancellation, SignalPattern, and FetchResponseOverrides were only used inside FetchOptions/SignalFilter; inlining keeps accepted option shapes while removing stale importable type aliases.
asi.result: Reduced ds.ts source while Datastar typed coverage for fetch options, signal filters, typecheck, tests, and build passed.
asi.risk: Medium-low: external code importing those helper aliases would need to use the structural option types directly, acceptable for this greenfield comparison branch.

description: chore: inline query URL parameter input type

asi.hypothesis: QueryParamInput is only used by queryUrl; inlining it keeps queryUrl's public parameter shape while removing a narrow helper alias.
asi.result: Reduced ds.ts source while queryUrl tests, typed coverage, typecheck, tests, and build passed.
asi.risk: Low for greenfield branch; code importing QueryParamInput can use ExprInput<string | number | boolean> directly.

description: chore: simplify response header merge

asi.hypothesis: Headers can be constructed from undefined, so mergeHeaders does not need a separate undefined branch before applying user overrides.
asi.result: Reduced reply.ts source while preserving default/user header override behavior; response tests, typecheck, full tests, and build passed.
asi.risk: Low; Headers constructor accepts undefined per Web API and response tests cover content-type/cache-control/custom headers.

description: chore: inline navigation allowlist origin check

asi.hypothesis: originOf was only used by safeNavigationUrl; checking allowlist URL origins inline removes a helper while preserving malformed-entry and protocol rejection behavior.
asi.result: Reduced reply.ts source while navigation allowlist/blocklist tests, typecheck, full tests, and build passed.
asi.risk: Low; malformed allowlist entries now simply do not match, which is equivalent to failing the final safe-navigation check for the requested URL.

description: chore: inline stream source type checks

asi.hypothesis: ReadableStream and AsyncIterable detection in reply.toAsyncIterable are single-use checks, so inlining them removes private type-guard helpers while keeping accepted stream inputs unchanged.
asi.result: Reduced reply.ts source while iterable, async iterable, Web Stream, heartbeat/live tests plus typecheck/build all passed.
asi.risk: Low; checks remain structural rather than instanceof-based, preserving cross-realm friendliness.

description: chore: inline ReadableStream iteration

asi.hypothesis: ReadableStream-to-AsyncIterable conversion is only used by toAsyncIterable; inlining it removes a private generator helper without changing stream support or reader cleanup.
asi.result: Reduced reply.ts source while Web Stream response tests, live stream cancellation behavior, typecheck, full tests, and build passed.
asi.risk: Low; reader.releaseLock remains in finally and stream tests exercise ReadableStream input.

description: chore: table-drive fetch option serialization

asi.hypothesis: Fetch option serialization repeats the same undefined-check/push pattern for each option; iterating a fixed key list should preserve Datastar option order and output while reducing code.
asi.result: Reduced ds.ts source substantially; typed coverage confirms exact fetch option output, and full typecheck/test/build passed.
asi.risk: Low; key order is explicit in fetchOptionKeys and mirrors the previous if-order.
